title: phagnalon rupestre subsp. morisianum
intro: Phagnalon rupestre subsp. morisianum, commonly known as Alpine Phagnalon, is a plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae) that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help alleviate pain and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Phagnalon rupestre subsp. morisianum include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, antitumor, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may contribute to its potential therapeutic uses. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is necessary to fully understand its effects.
